hook: Stranded on a roof in Harvey's flood. The basket was coming.
narration: Several people were stranded on a roof, and this basket was their way out.
Hurricane Harvey had flooded the Houston area. This was August 29, 2017.
The camera is on the helicopter's hoist, looking straight down at the roof.
The flight mechanic runs the hoist and talks the pilot into position, because the pilot cannot see below.
One at a time, the basket went down empty and came back up with a person.
outcome: The Air Station Houston crew lifted them off the roof and away from the flood.
title: Hoist camera over a flooded Houston roof
question_comment: Would you go first in the basket, or last?
